[[File:Reanimate Abyssal Creature icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Reanimate Abyssal Creature''' was a [[reanimation spell]] which required a [[Magic]] level of 85 and an [[ensouled abyssal head]] to cast. This spell would summon a [[Reanimated Abyssal Creature|reanimated abyssal]] with 35 [[hitpoints]]. As with its slayer counterpart, this creature still requires 85 Slayer to damage.

Upon killing the animated abyssal, players will gain 1,300 [[Prayer]] experience and 0.5% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]]. It also can be killed on an [[abyssal demon]] [[slayer task]].

Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has put the head into the bank, trade screen, Grand Exchange, or price checker, the reanimation spell will only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]].

The spell, alongside [[Reanimate Aviansie]] and [[Reanimate Dragon]], was removed and merged into the [[Master Reanimation]] spell in [[2021]].
